title: Swift at Apple: Migrating the TrueType hinting interpreter
summary: Apple's engineering team documented their experience migrating the TrueType hinting interpreter from C/C++ to Swift, showcasing real-world challenges of porting performance-critical font rendering code while maintaining compatibility and performance.
problem_solved: Modernizes legacy C/C++ font hinting interpreter code to benefit from Swift's type safety, memory safety, and better developer tooling while maintaining existing behavior.
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical Swift adoption for performance-sensitive systems code and provides insights into bridging Swift with legacy C interfaces in production environments.
